description: Source code for a command-line utility managing XBB device status, configuration, alarms, and control commands, including user input handling and device interaction functions.

methods.name: getInputLine
methods.description: Reads a line of input from stdin, dynamically reallocating buffer as needed.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Parses and executes user commands, returning 0 to exit.

methods.name: showInteractiveHelp
methods.description: Displays available commands and usage information.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the status of the XBB device.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the current configuration of the XBB device.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the device configuration based on input JSON string.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Discovers XBB devices, removing previously paired ones.

methods.name: getAlarms
methods.description: Retrieves and displays current alarms from the device.

methods.name: sirenStart
methods.description: Starts the siren with specified parameters.

methods.name: isBatteryPaired
methods.description: Checks if the battery is paired.
